Name: (CP) Sans as Shane Mod and New Dialogue
Author: DellPC
Description:
[size=4]The original creator of this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15057874]Givala[/url]﻿, has not updated the mod since February 2017. The portion of this mod with their content will/can be taken down upon request/them updating. Please refer to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/937]original page [/url]﻿for endorsement/voting on the matter. Thanks.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]

[size=3]Here's a updated sans mod if your feeling pretty [color=#00ff00]bonely[/color]. It even includes some new dialogue.

[size=4]Bug List:[/size]
Sans sometimes addressed as Shane in the JojaMart.
Other characters refer to Sans as Shane in some cutscenes/scenarios. 

If you find any Dialogue/Other issues, please list them. Thank you.

1.01: Fixed 8 heart event (Fashion cutscene) where Sans turns into Shane. Good thing that's fixed.
1.02: Added other-mod compatibility for last update (annoying, I know.)
